title: Mistral 7B
hook: Mistral 7B outperforms much larger open models on most benchmarks - showing that architecture choices and data quality can stretch a 7B parameter budget a long way.
key_points: Uses grouped-query attention (GQA) for faster inference and sliding-window attention (SWA) to handle long sequences efficiently.
Outperformed Llama 2 13B and matched or beat Llama 2 34B on several reasoning and coding benchmarks despite being smaller.
Released under Apache 2.0, one of the most permissive open-source licenses available.
Demonstrated that targeted architectural improvements can compensate for a smaller parameter count.
content_html: Jiang and colleagues at Mistral AI released Mistral 7B in October 2023, a 7-billion-parameter model that outperformed larger open-weight models on a range of reasoning, math, and code benchmarks. Its strong showing for its size drew attention to how much architectural efficiency choices matter at the 7B scale.
extra_html:
How it works

Mistral 7B uses two key attention modifications: grouped-query attention, which reduces the memory needed for the key-value cache and speeds up inference, and sliding-window attention, which lets the model process longer sequences without the quadratic cost of full self-attention. The combination makes the model fast and memory-efficient relative to its competitors at launch.

Why it matters

Mistral 7B showed the open community that an aggressively optimized smaller model could beat naive scaling to a larger parameter count. It also became a popular base for fine-tuning due to its Apache 2.0 license. Read the paper on arXiv.

related.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
related.hook: Meta released Llama 2 with open weights and a commercial-use license, giving anyone a strong RLHF-tuned chat model to build on - and kicked off a wave of open-LLM development.

related.title: Mixtral of Experts
related.hook: Mixtral packs 8 experts per layer but routes each token through only 2, so you get the capacity of a ~47B model at the compute cost of a ~13B one - open weights included.

related.title: Grouped-Query Attention (GQA)
related.hook: Split the difference between multi-head and multi-query attention: share KV heads across groups of query heads and get most of the memory savings with little quality loss.

flashcards.back_html: GQA shrinks the key-value cache and speeds inference; sliding-window attention handles long sequences without full self-attention's quadratic cost.

flashcards.prompt: What did Mistral 7B demonstrate to the open community?
